global: This tonkotsu ramen features a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and menma bamboo shoots nestled among noodles. Served in a white bowl with red trim, it rests on a wooden surface under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and subtle vertical lines.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red checkered pattern along its rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, holding curly noodles and green onions, with a central pork slice and a browned topping.
regions.spoon: Metallic spoon with reflective surface, rounded bowl, and four tines, showing slight wear and use.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is round, pale pink with browned edges, showing a tender, slightly fatty texture and visible seasoning.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, curved strips with visible fibrous texture and faint brownish edges.
